title: Review of c09's active-gel comets (SIME): replicated on seeds 7 and 8; substrate fork on seed 7 kills 8/8 comets by t=130; zeta=0 forms nothing
summary: Verdict written before reading other reviews. I looked at pack/seed0/tracks.png, motion_tracks.txt and starve_counts.txt, then ran the claimed world unchanged on new seeds 7 and 8, the starve fork world_starve.py on seed 7 and the zeta=0 ablation on seed 7 (T=200 each; world/, world_starve/, world_zeta0/). From white noise ~46 contractile peaks form, most starve, and 7 persistent comets remain (persistent tracks 7 on both seeds; world/seed7/tracks.png: a bright head with a faint regulator wake, constant small size from t~40 to 200). Motion: 31 and 22 tracks move >= 1 body length, max 7.9 and 9.0 body lengths, speed up to 0.53-0.56. Fork on seed 7: components 8 at t=120 in both arms; starved 3 at t=125 and 0 from t=130, fed 8-9 to t=200. zeta=0 on seed 7: no components at any time.

observations.I: world/seed7/tracks.png: four comets tracked t=15-200 at constant size; 7 persistent tracks
observations.M: world/seed7/FACTS.md 31 tracks >= 1 BL, max 7.9 BL; world/seed8/FACTS.md max 9.0 BL
observations.E: world_starve/seed7/metrics.json n_comp 8 (t=120) -> 3 (125) -> 0 (130) vs fed world/seed7 8-9 to t=200

controls_run.E: world_starve/seed7 (substrate removed at t=120, same seed) vs world/seed7
controls_run.M: world_zeta0/seed7 (no gel flow: no bodies at all)

verdicts.limitation: E holds by construction in the rubric's sense (the stress generator is made only from the substrate and decays), so it counts for the rung and should be scored under mechanism; the 10 t death after the cut is just the decay time. Bodies are tiny (area ~20 px, radius ~2.5 px); I did not re-run the dt/2 or 1.5x checks. zeta=0 removes the bodies entirely, so it ablates I as well as M; it is not a matched Laplacian twin for motility.
